text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While discussing race plans
with Rhein Kraft—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...U-Umm...
...There are... so many kitties... on my lap.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Mmuuuuh~~... So heavy...
A fluffy totem pole...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft seems to be having a nightmare...
Maybe she's worn out from back-to-back races.
It'd be wise to reconsider her upcoming schedule.
